title: Polaris Slingshot Guided Tour in Houston
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Riding a Polaris Slingshot on a guided tour through the back roads of northwest Houston, Texas is an exhilarating experience. The Slingshot is a three-wheeled, open-air vehicle that offers a unique combination of sportscar performance and motorcycle freedom. The tour will take you through scenic routes, picturesque countryside, and charming small towns. The guide will take you on a journey through the winding roads and rolling hills of the Texas Hill Country, offering breathtaking views and a chance to experience the natural beauty of the area. Expect a thrilling ride as you take in the sights and sounds of the Texas countryside while enjoying the open air experience and feeling the wind in your hair. It's a great way to explore the area and experience the unique culture and history of northwest Houston.

Each Slingshot seats two people and can accommodate groups of up to 20+

Drivers must be 25 or older with DL

Rentals are also available for 4 Hour, 1 Day, 2 Day, and 3 Day durations
